name: Airbook
title: airbook.io
shortDescription: Airbook is a GTM data platform designed for analytics and operations. It centralizes data from various sources, allowing users to analyze with AI or SQL and push results to their tools. Ideal for teams looking to explore revenue drivers and act on insights. For example, marketing teams can analyze campaign effectiveness and optimize strategies based on real-time data.
pros: Complete data workflow in one platform
Effortless, direct connections to data sources
cons: Potential high cost for enterprise scale
